The other 48 are worlds Phiegg already has: first those the original site on the D drive named (D:/Dowloads/Workspace/gemrepo/gemphi, worlds-data.ts) that are here under the same name, then Phiegg's own named worlds in the order core.json lists them, never a second world of a name already taken. app/phiegg/scripts/cities.py writes a `city` field on each: its number, `main` or `city`, and the set's name, so a tab can list them (data/route.json). A rerun clears every `city` field first.
